findings.title: Materials' 123% earnings bet is extreme
findings.body: Materials trades at 17.56x forward versus 39.09x trailing, a 55 percent compression that implies 123 percent earnings growth. That is the market underwriting a near-tripling of profits, a far more aggressive assumption than any other sector's implied growth.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' 41-point lens gap
findings.body: Consumer Staples sits at the 45th percentile on forward earnings but the 86th on trailing, a 41-point gap that is the widest among sectors. The market is pricing a 46 percent earnings jump, yet the sector's forward multiple is only mid-range, suggesting analysts expect a sharp rebound rather than sustained strength.

findings.title: Real Estate's month-long valuation collapse
findings.body: Real Estate's forward percentile fell 44 points in a month to the 23rd, while its forward P/E of 35.52 remains the highest in the table. The multiple has barely moved, so the drop is almost entirely about earnings estimates rising, not about the sector getting cheaper.
